notes.title: New Boss Rush Demo Now Available On Steam!
notes.content:
Hello Wanderers!

[b]With this announcement, we’ll go over:[/b]
- Boss Rush demo.
- Voice acting stretch goal.
- More Metroidvanias on Kickstarter.

[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1252994039691612334/1280464707651768340/image.png?ex=66d82d30&is=66d6dbb0&hm=0fe4b9c840bf617409050b0b3e36698b133e87b5cd023b5ff8f3dd743d6aadf3&[/img]

We’re happy to announce that our ‘[b]Boss Rush’ demo is now available to play on Steam[/b]. It’s different to the stretch goal ‘Boss Rush Mode’ unlocked last week but you’ll get a sneak of what’s to come in the new mode.

You’ll encounter 3 rare hunts and some of the monsters of the environments, and with you will be 3 Fated Bonds: Bjorn, Efimer and Trystan.

We featured this demo at Gamescom and the response was great! People loved the art - we had a lot of people stop and stare while people played the demo. Even the little wanderers enjoyed it!

[img]https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/046/317/488/556fa7f50287553f1436c828931eb703_original.jpg?origin=ugc&q=80&width=800&sig=nAqmENqP%2FVm9UWiyvVPT8KO1GKJ0xUTDa5s8%2B0k0lsc%3D[/img]

We had speedrunners complete the demo in 9m 21s, and no one managed to complete a flawless run. Let us know how you do in the comments below.

We think you’ll have a lot of fun with this and experience a taste of what's to come with Fallen Tear: The Ascension.

Download now on Steam!

Once you’ve had your fun with the demo, don’t forget to wishlist, share it with your friends and let us know what you think in the comments!

Want to know how to get your hands on 1 of 3 Hire figures for free? Head over to our X page and view our pinned post!


[b]More voices in the world of Raoah[/b]

We are edging closer to our 3rd stretch goal! The next stretch goal will add more English & Japanese voice acting into the world of Roaha.

The voice acting in the game right now includes some basic interactions within the game and with the stretch goal, we plan to have more interactions with the Fated Bonds and Hira, in game cutscenes and other main events that would elevate the scenes in game. We think this will add more feeling and depth to our characters, and help expand your experience when playing Fallen Tear: The Ascension.

Here’s some of the voices you’ll hear in Fallen Tear:

[b]Rhiannon Moushall as Lenela[/b]
[previewyoutube=W2ur9G3M0ZA;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Brandon Hunt as Trystan[/b]
[previewyoutube=7fJQy2VTAJA;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]


Thank you for showing your support and contributing towards Fallen Tear: The Ascension!

notes.title: Our 2021 in Review
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, Wanderer![/h2]

What a year, eh? We just want to cap off the last few December days by saying, we hope you had a good year. Here’s how ours went!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39731856/d67bc53bb376bc07f03eb69a3edb6ddba15a437e.png[/img]

We…

- launched our Steam page

- opened the official Fallen Tear Discord Server

- released a playable concept demo

- started and restarted our newsletter

- reached 3,000 followers on Twitter


and last but not least…

[b]We won the Audience Choice Award at the Level up KL Sea Game Awards! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39731856/7c1ba4a654ba6f524f474f3753d63d0629ca0da6.png[/img]

It was very surprising for us to even be nominated and even more surprising that we won. Again, if you follow our socials and also voted for us, a huge thank you for helping us win! It’s been a very busy year full of ups and downs for us; and we’re excited to see what 2022 will bring.

[h2][b]FOR THE LAST LEG OF 2021[/b][/h2]

[b]The last and biggest news for 2021 is us removing our playable concept demo from Steam. This will happen on December 31, so this is basically your last month to play it! [/b]

The game development has changed a lot since the demo and it's no longer accurate to the gameplay/experience we were aiming for. Expect exciting stuff next year and wait for our next announcements; plus an update to the Steam page.

Once everything's ready, you will be the first to know!


[h1]Please Continue to Support us into 2022![/h1]

[url=http://fallentearascension.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39731856/d7587f6d9418ce2f70fdeaee2c7e55dbc6a6f88f.jpg[/img][/url]

Sign up to our newsletter for exclusive news, updates and stories we don't share anywhere else!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/NBPAF3Mvv9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39731856/025effea8a2a20a4d8647c097865a0e096649a6e.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Where We've Been, Where We're Going, and the KL Awards
notes.content:
Hello, Wanderer!

So, we disappeared for a while and, first off, we want to thank you for your support! We honestly don’t know where the year went. We put our heads down to start working, looked up, and people are doing Christmas countdowns!

And here’s why:

[b]1. We got hyperfocused on our art.[/b] There’s absolutely no sugar coating it. We’re artists and have been working so hard to create and improve the characters, environments, and animations for Fallen Tear: The Ascension that we just looked up one day and found ourselves halfway into 2021 with just three emails sent.
[b]2. We were still consulting marketing experts.[/b] We know our way around games. Not so much with marketing them.
[b]3. We’ve been doing our own writing.[/b] And, let me tell you, as visual people, it’s been painful.

Luckily, we DID manage to wrangle a team to help us write and organize our efforts to stay in touch with you guys because we really wouldn’t be where we are without your support. Thank you so much for continuing to engage with us on Discord and other social media platforms. We have so much more to share! So we will get better at this. Starting now!

Did you know that we restarted our newsletter? If you’ve signed up for it, you probably know and have actually read the part above in an email a few weeks ago. If you still haven’t, please head over to fallentearascension.com and you will get dibs on all the updates and exclusives we have for the game. Every month, you will learn more about the characters, the story, and how our production is going.

And speaking of, the whole team is in full production mode creating new game levels, enemies, and new abilities! Though we are nowhere near finished, it IS starting to take shape already, which is why we will be pulling our concept demo from Steam by December this year. That demo isn’t actually an accurate depiction of our goals, and definitely not of our progress.

Here is our roadmap for next year...

[h1]Trailer for 2022[/h1]

For the rest of 2021 till next year, we will be working on a full-on trailer with all the fixins and more game features. Compared to the cinematic concept demo, which was initially just going to be a teaser, this trailer will show what makes our game new and badass. There will be more gameplay, less of the story, and more cinematics.

[h1]Kickstarter in 2022[/h1]

We also intend to run a Kickstarter in 2022. This would be an opportunity to fund even more features that, right now, are looking like a pipe dream working on our own. Supporters will also get merch! We did a similar thing with our loyal and active Discord community members earlier this year, and we sent them some Fallen Tear: The Ascension shirts.

[h1]Game Release 2023[/h1]

Game release is scheduled for 2023 and we are incredibly determined to meet our goal. This is, after all, our love letter to the gaming community that has shaped who we have become now. However, it would all depend on how 2022 and our Kickstarter goes. So sign up for our newsletter and join us on Discord to stay updated and let us know what you want to see in our game!

[h1]SEA Games Awards[/h1]
Before we sign off, we’re super excited to share that we are part of the [b][url=https://mdec.my/levelupkl/sea-game-awards/]Level Up KL’s 4th SEA Games Awards![/url][/b] Could you visit the link and give us a little vote if you could spare a couple of seconds and three clicks? The deadline is October 15, so vote now and tell your friends!


[h1]Please Support Us![/h1]

[url=http://fallentearascension.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39731856/d7587f6d9418ce2f70fdeaee2c7e55dbc6a6f88f.jpg[/img][/url]

We've been sending special updates in our emails and exclusive sneak peeks of our next plans in our email newsletter, so don't miss out and sign up today!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/NBPAF3Mvv9][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39731856/025effea8a2a20a4d8647c097865a0e096649a6e.jpg[/img][/url]

We also suggest joining our official discord channel to send feedback, talk with the devs, mingle with other players and meet members of the community. We are very interested to hear from you, and your feedback helps us shape the game! Recently we sent out freebies to our biggest supporters, so expect to hear more about these in the future!

notes.title: Concept Demo Update - JP VER. now available!
notes.content:

22人の仲間たちとのキズナを描くメトロイドヴァニア系2Dアクション――
『Fallen Tear : The Ascension』の体験版が日本語に対応しました！

日本語でプレイするためには、起動後、Options→Languageから日本語を選択してください。

この体験版では、戦闘、探索、成長システム、仲間とのキズナなどの基本的な要素を体験できます。ストーリーやステージなどは体験版専用のものとなっており、現在開発中の本編とは異なりますのでご注意ください。

体験版を気に入っていただけた方は、ウィッシュリストへの登録をお願いします！

そして今後の情報をお楽しみに！

notes.title: Concept Demo Launch Announcement
notes.content:
Hello Wanderers!

[b]In two weeks, on March 31st, we will be releasing the first public concept demo of Fallen Tear: The Ascension on Steam. [/b]

Though[b] the demo is completely separate from the main game,[/b] much of it being subject to change and development, it will feature core gameplay features such as our unique Ascension and Bond systems. It follows a side story that, while not part of the main game, provides an insight to the overarching plot and setting. 

We are also proud to announce that the music will be done by the very talented Lukas Piel, with flutes by Sandro Friedrich. Here is a music video they made of the game’s main theme : “Awakening”.

[previewyoutube=i1_E_hI3SW4;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you will join us on our first foray into the world of Raoah and the beginning of Hira’s journey! Wishlist us today!
